recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片鐵染色（Prussian blue）可見多個紅血球前驅細胞核周圍環繞一圈藍色含鐵顆粒，即環形鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）；周邊血與骨髓其他系列形態大致正常，配合貧血與 SF3B1 突變，符合 MDS-RS 單系發育不良。
features: Prussian blue aspirate: multiple erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules forming a perinuclear ring encircling at least one-third of the nucleus (ring sideroblasts)
Aspirate: erythroid precursors at all stages with some showing mildly megaloblastoid, open chromatin; granulocytic maturation present without obvious dysgranulopoiesis
Core biopsy: cellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis, clusters of erythroid precursors and megakaryocytes of normal size and lobation; focal interstitial edema/hemorrhage
Peripheral blood: normocytic RBCs with mild anisopoikilocytosis (occasional elliptocytes, teardrop and crenated cells), adequate platelets
Peripheral blood neutrophil with normal granulation and no convincing pseudo-Pelger-Huet change
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis including occasional elliptocytes and teardrop forms; platelets appear adequate and the neutrophils seen are normally granulated. The bone marrow core biopsy is cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis, erythroid clusters and megakaryocytes of normal size and nuclear lobation, without increased blasts. The aspirate shows erythroid precursors at all stages of maturation, some with mildly megaloblastoid chromatin, and granulocytic maturation without obvious dysplasia. Iron stain shows numerous ring sideroblasts with coarse siderotic granules encircling at least one-third of the nuclear circumference. In the setting of anemia, exclusion of reactive causes and an SF3B1 mutation, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with ring sideroblasts and single lineage dysplasia (MDS-RS-SLD).

ddx.dx: Congenital or acquired non-clonal sideroblastic anemia (alcohol, copper deficiency, zinc toxicity, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Reactive sideroblastic anemias can show identical ring sideroblasts, so the discriminator is clinical history, copper/zinc levels and absence of an SF3B1 mutation or clonal cytogenetic abnormality.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: MDS/MPN-RS-T has a platelet count of at least 450,000/uL with large MPN-like megakaryocytes, whereas this patient has a normal platelet count and megakaryocytes of normal morphology.
MDS-RS-MLD requires dysplasia in at least 10% of cells of two or more lineages, whereas dysplasia here is essentially confined to the erythroid lineage.

B12/folate deficiency gives macrocytosis, hypersegmented neutrophils, giant metamyelocytes and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony without numerous ring sideroblasts, and the vitamin B12 level is normal in this patient.
